sources.title: OpenStreetMap water-body polygons across the Kolkata Metropolitan Area

conventions.water_value_allowlist: Only enumerated water= values are admitted. river polygons are EXCLUDED: admitted naively, the Hooghly becomes the largest 'water body' in Kolkata at 1,828 ha. Unknown future values default to excluded rather than included.

provenance.note: Rabindra and Subhash Sarobar are OSM relations, not ways, and OSM spells them 'Sarobar'. A ways-only query silently loses both.
